detail: The standardised meals of every study day (07:00, 13:00 and 19:00 with a 22:00 snack, Methods) are printed with no energy, grams or composition, and every sampled value follows them (the day 1 and day 2 values after one or two such days), so no arm can be written, and the headline melatonin and metabolite series are in any case a marker the model has no series for.
